blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Alas Pilipinas national team will take the court in the men’s volleyball tournament at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026. Alas Pilipinas men, hoping to produce better results than their women’s counterparts, are in Pool D with South Korea, China and Chinese Taipei in the preliminary phase. In Pool A are Pakistan, Kazakhstan, Japan and Uzbekistan; Pool B has Iran, Kyrgzstan, Indonesia and Thailand; while Pool C is composed of Qatar, Hong Kong, India and Vietnam.
